messages:
kevin_acme: submitted a support form 2024-05-05 14:02 UTC — says 100 trial credits landed on a different workspace (screenshot in ticket).

liam: pulled the ticket, looks like credits are on 'acme-old' but customer expects 'acme-prod'. customer gave org ids in their email.

kevin_acme: correct org is acme-prod (org id org_02Xb9A1). credits are on acme-old (org id org_00LmZ7Y). promo code used: TRIAL-100-2024 on 2024-05-02.

maya: quick question — did they sign up via SSO or create an account manually? duplicates usually come from "Create workspace" during SSO flows.

kevin_acme: they used Google SSO and accidentally hit "Create a new workspace" instead of joining the existing one. ended up with acme-old.

liam: short repro from customer: 1) sign in with Google SSO 2) click Create workspace instead of Join 3) name it slightly different (acme-old) 4) apply promo at redemption and credits attach to that new org.

tanya: billing note — promo redemptions are bound to the org that redeems them. we don't auto-move credits. will need a manual transfer if they want them consolidated. can you paste the redemption audit entry?

liam: pulled admin audit, got this line:
```n2024-05-02T16:12:03Z promo_redemption code=TRIAL-100-2024 actor_email=kevin@acme.com org_id=org_00LmZ7Y txn_id=tx_7gY3
```

tanya: ok, I can perform a one-off transfer from org_00LmZ7Y -> org_02Xb9A1 but we need to verify ownership and get support manager sign-off.

liam: verified via SSO metadata: kevin@acme.com is org admin on acme-prod and also listed on acme-old. customer confirmed they intend acme-prod to be the destination.

maya: approving transfer for billing ops. include a short audit note for both orgs and advise customer to avoid creating duplicate workspaces (suggest using invite link).

tanya: running internal transfer now. command used (internal tool):
```nPOST /internal/billing/transfer_credits
{
  "from_org":"org_00LmZ7Y",
  "to_org":"org_02Xb9A1",
  "amount":100,
  "reason":"duplicate workspace redemption, customer requested transfer"
}
```

billing-bot: transfer success — tx_id=tx_8hK5, amount=100 credits moved, completed at 2024-05-05T16:45:10Z.

tanya: added a one-line audit note to both org records and closed the promo ticket. also asked eng to add a signup modal warning to reduce accidental workspace creation for emails already associated with an org.

liam: messaged the customer with details and asked them to confirm they see the balance on acme-prod.

kevin_acme: confirmed at ~17:01 UTC — "I see the 100 credits in acme-prod now, thank you! :tada:"

maya: marking this resolved. follow-up action: liam to draft a short KB for support with required approvals, audit entry format, and the transfer playbook.

liam: will post the KB to #support-kb and close the thread.
